h1: Custom Jackets for Teams, Events & Safety Programs
metaDescription: Order custom jackets with your logo for corporate events, safety programs, and team uniforms. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround.
introHtml:
Marketing directors planning a cohesive brand presence at outdoor events, HR directors assembling employee welcome kits for cold-weather facilities, and safety managers outfitting crews with high-visibility outerwear all turn to custom jackets for a practical, lasting impression. Whether you need lightweight rain protection for a trade show giveaway or insulated vests for a year-round uniform program, this category covers everything from the Rains® Jacket and Nor'Easter Rain Jacket to the Carhartt® Duck Vest and Boundary Fleece Jacket. Ponchos, youth sizes, and accessory items like the Poncho Ball Key Chain round out the selection for diverse use cases.

Custom jackets serve as walking billboards for your organization while keeping recipients warm and dry. Decoration options like screen printing, embroidery, and heat transfer allow you to add your logo in high-visibility placements. Bulk orders typically start at 12 to 24 pieces per style, with lower per-unit costs at higher quantities. Use this page to explore the range, compare features like waterproofing and insulation, and request a quote tailored to your group size and timeline.
buyingGuideHtml:
What to Look for in Custom Jackets

When ordering custom jackets, start with the intended use. A lightweight rain jacket like the Shed Rain™ Poncho suits outdoor event staff, while insulated options like the Boundary Fleece Jacket work better for construction crews or winter giveaways. Check the fabric weight, waterproof rating, and seam sealing for rainwear. For vests, look for durable materials like cotton duck or fleece that hold up to daily wear. Pockets, hoods, and reflective details add functionality for safety programs or outdoor work.

Materials and Build Quality

Branded jackets come in a range of materials. Polyester shells with a DWR coating resist light rain, while nylon or PVC ponchos offer full waterproofing. Fleece jackets provide warmth without bulk, and cotton duck vests like the Carhartt® Duck Vest are rugged for industrial settings. For all-weather protection, consider a 3-in-1 jacket system. Always verify care instructions: some materials require gentle washing to preserve the waterproof layer or printed logo.

Common Use Cases and Buyer Personas

Promotional jackets fit many scenarios. Marketing directors order logo-printed jackets for trade show giveaways or client gifts that keep the brand visible season after season. HR directors use personalized jackets for employee onboarding kits or safety incentive programs. Safety managers choose bulk jackets with high-visibility accents for crews in construction, utilities, or landscaping. Business owners often invest in wholesale jackets for company uniforms that project a professional image at job sites or retail locations.

Decoration and Customization Options

Embroidery is the most popular method for custom jackets because it looks premium and lasts. It works well on fleece, canvas, and polyester shells. Screen printing is cost-effective for large quantities on smooth fabrics like nylon or polyester. Full-color heat transfer or sublimation allows detailed logos on performance fabrics. For rainwear, avoid screen printing on waterproof membranes that can compromise breathability. Instead, use heat-applied transfers or embroidery on compatible panels.

Quantity Guidance and MOQ Context

Minimum order quantities for custom jackets typically range from 12 to 24 pieces per style and color. Smaller runs are possible but may have higher per-unit costs. As order size increases, bulk pricing drops significantly. For example, ordering 100+ jackets often brings the unit price down by 20–30% compared to a 24-piece order. If you need multiple sizes, order a balanced mix to stay within the MOQ per size. Many suppliers offer tiered pricing, so request quotes for your exact quantity to compare.

Common Buying Mistakes to Avoid

One frequent mistake is choosing a jacket style that doesn't match the climate or activity. A lightweight poncho won't work for winter outdoor work, and a heavy parka is overkill for indoor giveaways. Another pitfall is ignoring size charts: jacket sizing varies widely between brands, so provide a size range based on actual measurements. Also, consider decoration placement: avoid embroidering over zippers or pockets that distort the logo. Finally, factor in lead time: custom jackets often take 3–4 weeks, so plan ahead for seasonal events.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom jackets?
faqs.a: Most custom jacket orders require a minimum of 12 to 24 pieces per style and color. Some styles may have higher MOQs. Contact us for specific MOQ details on the jacket you're interested in.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we can provide a blank sample of most jacket styles for a nominal fee. This allows you to check the fit, fabric, and quality before committing to a full production run.

faqs.q: What decoration methods work best for jackets?
faqs.a: Embroidery is the most durable and professional option for jackets, especially on fleece and canvas. Screen printing works well on smooth polyester or nylon shells. Full-color heat transfer is ideal for detailed logos on performance fabrics.

faqs.q: How long does production take for custom jackets?
faqs.a: Standard production lead time is 3 to 4 weeks from approval of the artwork and payment. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Always plan ahead for seasonal events.

faqs.q: Do you offer sizing for youth or plus sizes?
faqs.a: Yes, many jacket styles come in youth sizes, and plus sizes are available for select adult styles. Check the product page for size range details or ask your sales representative for options.
